prices.method: Daily bars from the stored grouped-daily files. 8EMA = EMA(8) of daily closes. 20D VWAP = sum(typical price x volume) / sum(volume) over 20 sessions, typical = (high+low+close)/3. EMA and VWAP need unbroken consecutive sessions ending at the last bar (a missing session makes them n/a). 52W = up to the last 252 sessions (rows with fewer, or with missing sessions, show the session count and the missing count). A ticker whose last bar is older than the newest session shows that date and no derived metrics. Reference closes (since first buy / since filed) are n/a when the store does not cover that date.

clusters.rule: Cluster = 2 or more distinct insiders with open-market Form 4 code P buys of the same company, each within 10 days of the next. One row per company (newest cluster window; earlier windows counted). IPO/SPAC allocation suspects hidden by default (first daily bar within 30 days before the first buy, or a code C conversion in the same filing with a shared price).

f13.scope: All market caps (Massive overview at quarter end; cap filter: under $2B = micro/small, $2B+ = mid/large), common shares only (no puts/calls/notes). Rows whose CUSIP maps to a non-US listing are excluded (the ticker and cap belong to another company). Rows whose 13F issuer name does not match the ticker name, or whose position is over 30% of market cap, are kept and flagged for a check. Filing date and link are the latest 13F filing for the quarter (an amendment when one exists); the original date is kept on amended rows.
f13.source: D:/AustinData/sbr/13f/diffs/<cik>.json transitions[from=2026-03-31, to=2026-06-30]; totals + filed dates from 13f/<cik>/<quarter>.json

politicians.senate_note: Senate eFD sits behind an "I agree" gate, so it is not in this data path; the public Senate mirrors stopped in 2021.

sources.prices: D:/AustinData/sbr/grouped (local grouped daily bars; 466 sessions loaded from 2024-11-18 to 2026-09-29; 52w high = max daily high over the last 252 sessions; EMA8 of closes)
sources.caps: edgar-feed cache, latest dated Massive overview snapshot per ticker (cap as of market_cap_asof, not re-priced)

gaps: SENATE NOT COVERED: Senate eFD requires clicking an "I agree" gate (not automated); public Senate JSON mirrors are frozen at 2021. Every row is chamber=House.
Image-only (paper/scanned) House PTRs have no text layer and are not parsed; they are listed in skipped_filings.
Amounts are the STOCK Act ranges (low/high), never exact. Option rows (OP) keep the underlying ticker; strike/expiry stay in the asset text.
Window is by FILED date (what is knowable today); trade dates can be older. Trades made but not yet filed are invisible (45-day filing allowance).
Non-stock assets (treasuries, munis, funds without ticker, crypto) are excluded; counts in excluded_by_reason.
Family-owned rows (owner SP/JT/DC) are included and flagged in `owner`; they are the member's reportable holdings, not necessarily the member's own decisions.
